question: What is the shortcut key to create subscript in MS-Word?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ctrl + =__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **subscript is a number, figure, symbol, or indicator that is smaller than the normal line of type and is set slightly below it**.

 
 
• For ex- Formula of Carbon Dioxide is **CO₂.**
 
• The shortcut key to create subscript in MS-Word is Ctrl + =.
 
 
 
• A **superscript **is a number, figure, symbol, or indicator that is smaller than the normal line of type and is set slightly above it.
 
 
• For ex- ion of sodium is **Na​⁺¹.**
 
• For superscript, press Ctrl, Shift, and the Plus sign (+) at the same time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __**Purpose**__
